description: Composite signatures (ML-DSA-65 with Ed25519, RFC 10073) made by two programs, and what must be refused. Every signature is of `message`, by the key of `seed` on the network `network_id`, in the context of its purpose. Those under `python` were made by tests/profile_reference.py with the `cryptography` package and are randomized. Those under `go` were made by profile_check.go with crypto/mldsa in its deterministic mode, so that it rebuilds them byte for byte. Under `invalid`, a field that is absent is the one given at the top, and every case is verified for the purpose kern.tx.
